ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85-90% low-intensity (black) pixels vs 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed in localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters concentrated on the distal-central section of the right lobe; scattered high-intensity points on the left lobe; high-intensity calcifications at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with higher frequency and pixel-amplitude at the distal tips, transitioning to smoother undulations near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct convex curvature along the trailing boundary extending from the median notch to the lobe apex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular high-contrast white pixel clusters on the right lobe; sparse, smaller circular clusters on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, discrete white linear marks; most prominent is a diagonal scratch on the inner right lobe near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified barnacle encrustations visible at the apex of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe features a unique, high-density 'galaxy' pattern of interlocking white rosette scars.
